launcher.acknowledgements.title: Acknowledgements
launcher.acknowledgements.description: Our thanks to everyone who shared ideas, encouragement, and practical support, and to the open-source communities whose work makes DSH Launcher possible.
launcher.acknowledgements.hairyf: Thanks to hairyf for the thoughtful exchanges and for open-sourcing the DeepSeek Harness desktop wrapper, which gave this project a solid foundation and the opportunity for further development.
launcher.acknowledgements.marcogh: Thanks to MarcoG-h for the exchanges, encouragement, and sponsorship of 135 credits in tokens, which provided practical support for development and testing.
launcher.acknowledgements.dsh: Thanks to DeepSeek Harness for being open source and for its “everything is a plugin” philosophy, giving community developers an open, flexible foundation on which new ideas can become real extensions.
launcher.acknowledgements.tauri: Thanks to Tauri for a lightweight, secure, cross-platform desktop foundation that connects the launcher interface with native system capabilities.
launcher.acknowledgements.react: Thanks to React for its mature component model, which underpins the launcher's interactive, state-driven interface.
launcher.acknowledgements.vite: Thanks to Vite for fast and dependable frontend development and build tooling.
launcher.acknowledgements.heroui: Thanks to HeroUI for accessible, composable interface components that help keep the launcher consistent and clear.
launcher.acknowledgements.i18next: Thanks to i18next for mature internationalization support and a consistent experience across languages.
launcher.acknowledgements.pcl: Thanks to Meloong-Git's PCL (Plain Craft Launcher) for an excellent launcher interface design to reference; this project's layout and interactions draw from its design language.

launcher.collaboration.template_desc_cod: Plan → Develop → Review → Summarize coding pipeline
launcher.collaboration.template_task_cod: Break the requirements into a development plan: clarify goals, scope, tech choices, and deliverables, and write the plan into a Markdown document in the workspace.
Implement code according to the plan: read the plan document in the workspace, write or modify code, run tests, and produce the code plus a change summary.
Review the developed code: check correctness, readability, security, and edge cases, then output a review report with suggested fixes.
Consolidate the plan, development, and review outputs into a final summary: what was done, open issues, and next steps.
launcher.collaboration.template_task_doc: Produce a document outline for the topic: audience, structure, and key points per section.
Draft the full document following the outline, with clear language and accurate examples.
Proofread the document for facts, structure, and typos; output revision suggestions and the revised draft.
launcher.collaboration.template_desc_cod: Analyze → Review → Suggest fixes review pipeline
launcher.collaboration.template_task_cod: Read the codebase and produce a structural analysis with a summary of change points.
Review the code based on the analysis summary; output a list of issues with severity and rationale.
Provide fix suggestions for the review findings, or produce the fix plan directly.
